articles.summary: Virtual try-on helps consumers choose products. Adeia explores what comes next: context-aware beauty technology that considers the makeup people own and recommends how to use or adjust it as lighting, locations and plans change throughout the day.
articles.title: Adeia Takes Giant Steps: Beyond Virtual Try-On Technology: Context-Aware Makeup Assistance

articles.title: Grateful for the People Behind Adeia
